# tools: add 1password cli

Add the [1Password CLI](https://1password.com/developers/) (`op`) to the toolset. **Motivation:** "improve experience to work with secrets" — read credentials from the vault in scripts instead of keeping tokens such as `NGROK_TOKEN` in the environment.
